questions.stem: What is the definition of electrolysis?

options.text: The process of dissolving metals in acid
The decomposition of an ionic compound using electricity
The process of passing heat through a solid compound
The formation of ionic compounds from their elements

questions.explanation: Electrolysis is the decomposition (breaking down) of an ionic compound using electricity. The ionic compound being decomposed is called the electrolyte and must be molten or in solution so that the ions are free to move to the electrodes.
